question: Find the allowable values of $x$ in $y=\sqrt{x+2}+1/(x-1)$.
solution: The radicand must satisfy $x+2\ge0$, giving $x\ge-2$. The denominator must satisfy $x-1\ne0$, giving $x\ne1$. Both conditions must hold.
